question: Is direction D003 already explored or contradicted: Keep the valid-time, retrieval-agnostic framing of D001/D002 and additionally fix the outcome hierarchy: version-level contamination and version confusion are primary; answer accuracy is a co-primary only on queries that pass an answer-differential screen (retrieving a non-gold version would change the reference answer); retrieval metrics and abstention are diagnostic. Report the answer-differential pass rate, and treat a low pass rate as an informative negative result about the practical significance of version confusion rather than a failure to measure.?
rationale: A refined direction must be checked against existing work before it is recommended.
